breadcrumb: 04. NXTClean Fuels (Governor Tina Kotek support letter)
tldr: Governor Tina Kotek writes to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers supporting the NXTClean Fuels facility at Port Westward in Columbia County. She argues this $3 billion renewable fuels project will generate significant economic benefits—3,000+ construction jobs, 240 permanent positions, and $45+ million annual tax revenue—while displacing 750 million gallons of fossil fuels annually and reducing 7+ million tons of CO₂ emissions. The facility has received state environmental permits; Kotek urges the federal agency to approve it promptly.

bullets.text: Project represents $3 billion private investment in renewable fuels facility
Expected to generate over 3,000 union construction jobs and 240 permanent positions
Will contribute more than $45 million annually in tax revenue plus over $5.5 million in fees to Port of Columbia County
Received Removal-Fill Permit from Oregon Department of State Lands and 401 Water Quality Certification from Oregon Department of Environmental Quality
Will produce Renewable Diesel and Sustainable Aviation Fuel, displacing up to 750 million gallons of fossil fuels annually
Will reduce over 7 million tons of carbon dioxide emissions
Will restore over 470 acres of adjacent land into wetlands along Columbia River
Governor urges U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to give full and timely consideration to project

bureaus: Oregon Department of Land Conservation and Development
